## Data from Vannmiljø    

We use data extracted from Vannmiljø, filtered by program (Ocean Acidification) and years (2023-2024)  

```{r}

fn <- "../data/vannmiljo_ocean-acidification_2022-2024.xlsx"
dat_all <- read_excel(fn, guess_max = 17900) 

if (FALSE){
  table(dat_all$Vannlokalitetsnavn)
}

```



## One model per region

### Define regions

### Add the 'region' column to the data  

```{r}

dat_all2 <- dat_all |> 
  left_join(lookup_region, 
            by = join_by(Vannlokalitetsnavn),
            relationship = "many-to-one") |> 
  filter(!is.na(region))

```

## Analysis per region

For each region, we estimate the marginal mean pH based on the following linear model:   
```
pH ~ station + year_f + season*depth
```
Factors: 
- station: station name (categorical)
- year_f: year (categorical)
- season: the four meteorological seasons (categorical)  
- depth: sample depth (continuous)  

By taking the marginal mean, we avoid biased estimates due to imbalanced sampling, e.g. imbalance among seasons   

### Function for checking map

```{r}

check_map <- function(data){
  df_stations <- data |> 
    count(Vannlokalitetsnavn, Betegnelse, `UTM33 Ost (X)`, `UTM33 Nord (Y)`) |> 
    st_as_sf(coords = c("UTM33 Ost (X)", "UTM33 Nord (Y)"),
             crs = 25833) |> 
    st_transform(4326)
  coord <- st_coordinates(df_stations)
  df_stations$x <- coord[,1]
  df_stations$y <- coord[,2]
  df_stations |> 
    mutate(popup = paste0(Vannlokalitetsnavn, "<br>", Betegnelse)) |> 
    # filter(grepl("Barentshav", Vannlokalitetsnavn)) |> 
    leaflet() |> 
    addTiles() |> 
    addMarkers(~x, ~y, popup = ~popup)
}

```

### Barentshavet deep oceanic

```{r}

dat <- dat_all2 |> 
  filter(region %in% "Barentshavet",
         !(grepl("Straumsfjord", Vannlokalitetsnavn) |
         grepl("Stjernsundet", Vannlokalitetsnavn)),
         Parameter_id %in% "PHT",
         Ovre_dyp >= 100)
# table(is.na(dat$Betegnelse))
# table(addNA(dat$Betegnelse))

# check_map(dat)

dat <- dat |> 
  mutate(
    Betegnelse = as.numeric(Betegnelse),
    cruise = substr(Vannlokalitetsnavn, 1, 12),
    station = paste0(cruise, sprintf("%02.0f", Betegnelse)),
    year = year(Tid_provetak),
    year_f = factor(year),
    month = month(Tid_provetak),
    season = case_when(
      month %in%  3:5 ~ "Spring (MAM)",
      month %in%  6:8 ~ "Summer (JJA)",
      month %in%  9:11 ~ "Autumn (SON)",
      month %in% c(12,1,2) ~ "Winter (DJF)"),
    season = factor(season, 
                    levels = c("Winter (DJF)", "Spring (MAM)",
                               "Summer (JJA)","Autumn (SON)")),
    year_month = sprintf("%.2f", year + month/100),
  depth = cut(Ovre_dyp, breaks = c(0,5,10,20,50,100,200,500))
  )

if (FALSE){
  hist(dat$Nedre_dyp)
  xtabs(~cruise, dat)
  xtabs(~station, dat)
  xtabs(~year_month + station, dat)
  xtabs(~season + depth + station, dat)
  # xtabs(~paste(Ovre_dyp, Nedre_dyp) + Vannlokalitetsnavn, dat)
}


mod <- lm(Verdi ~ station + year_f + season*depth, data = dat)  

# check  
plot_grid(
  visreg(mod, "year_f"),
  visreg(mod, "season", "depth") + easy_rotate_x_labels(-15), 
  visreg(mod, "station") + easy_rotate_x_labels(-15), 
  ncol = 1)

emm <- emmeans(mod, ~ depth, weights = "equal")
est_barents_deep_oceanic_d <- summary(emm)

# Refit model with only the existing depths
sel <- is.na(summary(emm)$emmean)
sel_depths <- summary(emm)$depth[!sel]
dat2 <- dat |> filter(depth %in% sel_depths)
if (length(sel_depths)>1){ mod <- lm(Verdi ~ station + year_f + season*depth, data = dat2)  } else { mod <- lm(Verdi ~ station + year_f + season, data = dat2)   }  

emm <- emmeans(mod, ~ 1, weights = "equal")
est_barents_deep_oceanic <- summary(emm)

```

         Ovre_dyp <= 20)

### Norskehavet shallow oceanic

```{r}

  filter(region %in% "Norskehavet",
         !(grepl("Skrova", Vannlokalitetsnavn) |

           grepl("Tromsø-Svalbard 1", Vannlokalitetsnavn)),
         Parameter_id %in% "PHT",
         Ovre_dyp <= 20)

    Betegnelse = as.numeric(Betegnelse),

  )

  xtabs(~cruise, dat)
  xtabs(~station, dat)
  xtabs(~year_month + station, dat)
  xtabs(~season + depth + station, dat)

           grepl("Tromsø-Svalbard 1", Vannlokalitetsnavn)),
         Parameter_id %in% "PHT",
         Ovre_dyp <= 20)
# table(is.na(dat$Betegnelse))
# table(addNA(dat$Betegnelse))

# check_map(dat)

dat <- dat |> 
  mutate(
    Betegnelse = as.numeric(Betegnelse),
    cruise = substr(Vannlokalitetsnavn, 1, 12),
        station = paste0(cruise,                       ifelse(is.na(Betegnelse), "", sprintf("%02.0f", Betegnelse))                      ),
    year = year(Tid_provetak),
    year_f = factor(year),
    month = month(Tid_provetak),
    season = case_when(
      month %in%  3:5 ~ "Spring (MAM)",
      month %in%  6:8 ~ "Summer (JJA)",
      month %in%  9:11 ~ "Autumn (SON)",
      month %in% c(12,1,2) ~ "Winter (DJF)"),
    season = factor(season, 
                    levels = c("Winter (DJF)", "Spring (MAM)",
                               "Summer (JJA)","Autumn (SON)")),
    year_month = sprintf("%.2f", year + month/100),
  depth = cut(Ovre_dyp, breaks = c(0,5,10,20,50,100,200,500))
  )

if (FALSE){
  hist(dat$Nedre_dyp)
  xtabs(~cruise, dat)
  xtabs(~station, dat)
  xtabs(~year_month + station, dat)
  xtabs(~season + depth + station, dat)
  # xtabs(~paste(Ovre_dyp, Nedre_dyp) + Vannlokalitetsnavn, dat)
}


mod <- lm(Verdi ~ station + year_f + season*depth, data = dat)  

# check  
plot_grid(
  visreg(mod, "year_f"),
  visreg(mod, "season", "depth") + easy_rotate_x_labels(-15), 
  visreg(mod, "station") + easy_rotate_x_labels(-15), 
  ncol = 1)

emm <- emmeans(mod, ~ depth, weights = "equal")
est_norskehavet_shallow_coastal_d <- summary(emm)

# Refit model with only the existing depths
sel <- is.na(summary(emm)$emmean)
sel_depths <- summary(emm)$depth[!sel]
dat2 <- dat |> filter(depth %in% sel_depths)
if (length(sel_depths)>1){ mod <- lm(Verdi ~ station + year_f + season*depth, data = dat2)  } else { mod <- lm(Verdi ~ station + year_f + season, data = dat2)   }  

emm <- emmeans(mod, ~ 1, weights = "equal")
est_norskehavet_shallow_coastal <- summary(emm)

```

## Final results  

Combine 

```{r}

est_overall_region <- bind_rows(
  est_barents_deep_oceanic |> mutate(region = "barents_deep_oceanic"),
  est_barents_deep_coastal |> mutate(region = "barents_deep_coastal"),
  est_barents_shallow_oceanic |> mutate(region = "barents_shallow_oceanic"),
  est_barents_shallow_coastal |> mutate(region = "barents_shallow_coastal"),
  est_norskehavet_deep_oceanic |> mutate(region = "norskehavet_deep_oceanic"),
  est_norskehavet_deep_coastal |> mutate(region = "norskehavet_deep_coastal"),
  est_norskehavet_shallow_oceanic |> mutate(region = "norskehavet_shallow_oceanic"),
  est_norskehavet_shallow_coastal |> mutate(region = "norskehavet_shallow_coastal"),
  est_skagerrak_deep_oceanic |> mutate(region = "skagerrak_deep_oceanic"),
  est_skagerrak_deep_coastal |> mutate(region = "skagerrak_deep_coastal"),
  est_skagerrak_shallow_oceanic |> mutate(region = "skagerrak_shallow_oceanic"),
  est_skagerrak_shallow_coastal |> mutate(region = "skagerrak_shallow_coastal")
  )

est_overall_region

```

summary(mod)$coef

## APPENDIX 2: testing mixed models

```{r}

if (FALSE){
  library(lme4)
  
  # cruise fixed, station random
  mod <- lmer(
    Verdi ~ cruise + season + depth + year_f +
      (1 | cruise:station),
    data = dat
  )
  
  # cruise and station fixed
  mod <- lm(
    Verdi ~ cruise/station + season + depth + year_f,
    data = dat
  )
  
  summary(mod)
  
}

```

## APPENDIX 3 - Leaflet map  

```{r}

if (FALSE){
  
  library(leaflet)
  library(sf)
  
  df_stations <- dat_all |> 
    count(Vannlokalitetsnavn, Betegnelse, `UTM33 Ost (X)`, `UTM33 Nord (Y)`)
  df_stations_coord <- df_stations |> 
    st_as_sf(coords = c("UTM33 Ost (X)", "UTM33 Nord (Y)"),
             crs = 25833) |> 
    st_transform(4326) |> 
    st_coordinates()
  str(df_stations_coord)
  df_stations$x <- df_stations_coord[,1]
  df_stations$y <- df_stations_coord[,2]
  
  df_stations |> 
    filter(grepl("Barentshav", Vannlokalitetsnavn)) |> 
    # filter(grepl("Straumsfjorden", Vannlokalitetsnavn)) |> 
    # filter(grepl("Barentshav ", Vannlokalitetsnavn),
    #        as.numeric(Betegnelse) %in% 7:17) |> 
    leaflet() |> 
    addTiles() |> 
    addMarkers(~x, ~y, popup = ~Vannlokalitetsnavn)
}

```

## APPENDIX 4 - reading all files from MDir data tool

```{r}

if (FALSE){
  
  # data not added to github
  
  data_dir <- "data_pH"  
  fn_all <- dir(data_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  fn_mdir <- grep("mdir", fn_all, value = TRUE)
  fn_full <- paste0(data_dir, "/", fn_mdir)
  
  # test
  test <- read_excel(fn_full[1], skip = 1)
  
  # read all
  dat <- map(fn_mdir, read_excel, skip = 1)
  names(dat) <- fn_mdir  
  
  
}
  
  
```
